simple.meaning: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֵּן (H1121) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
